results.note: Commentarius in Amos - no evidence of English translation found despite searches for both the work and Rufinus/Auctor incertus bibliography.
Commentarius in Joel - no English translation located in searches for this specific work or related biblical commentaries by Rufinus.
Commentarius in LXXV psalmos - searches found Rufinus's preface to Origen's Commentary on Psalms 36-38 translated, but not this complete commentary on 75 psalms.
Commentarius in Oseam - no English translation found in searches for this work on Hosea.

Libellus de fide - very brief work (416 words); unclear if attributed to Rufinus Aquileiensis or Rufinus Syrus; searches show Mary William Miller translation exists for 'Liber de fide' but attribution ambiguous.

Liber de fide - Sister Mary William Miller published critical text and English translation (Catholic University of America Press, Patristic Studies XCVI, 1964). Also provisional translations available on Academia.edu.
Vita Sanctae Eugeniae - searches found Old English Vita by Ælfric referencing this, and academic analysis of the Latin, but no complete English translation of the original located.
Prologus (135 words, vol. 73) - appears to be preamble to Verba seniorum collection; classification depends on whether counted as part of that work.

Verba seniorum - this is the Latin Sayings of the Desert Fathers collection with multiple free English translations available: Benedicta Ward (1975), John Wortley (2012-2014), and others in open-access collections.
Brevis chronica - no English translation found despite searches for Claudius Taurinensis's works.
Enarratio in epistolam ad Galatas - translated by Allen Cabaniss in 'Early Medieval Theology' (Library of Christian Classics IX, Westminster Press/SCM Press, 1957).
Excerpta ex Commentariis ejus in Epistolas Pauli - no specific English translation located despite searches.
Expositio epistolae ad Philemonem - uploaded as English translation paper on Academia.edu by Undusted Texts blog (2024), but uncertain if this is scholarly publication or hobbyist translation.
Praefatio In Commentarios ad Epistolas Pauli - no English translation found in searches.
Praefatio in Catenam super Matthaeum - no English translation located.
Praefatio in epistolam ad Ephesios - no English translation found.
Praefatio - no English translation identified despite searches for Claudius Taurinensis prefaces.
Apologeticum - no English translation found in searches for this short Claudius work (1748 words).
Notitia historica 1 - no English translation found despite searches for Flodoard's shorter historical works.
Notitia historica 2 - no English translation located in searches.
Annales - English translation by Steven Fanning and Bernard S. Bachrach, 'The Annals of Flodoard of Reims, 919-966' (Broadview Press, 2004; Readings in Medieval Civilizations and Cultures series).
Auctarium - no English translation found despite searches for Flodoard's supplementary historical works.
De triumphis Christi Antiochiae - searches found only partial/fragmentary translations of this epic (nearly 20,000 lines), not complete English edition.
De triumphis Christi apud Italiam - no complete English translation located; this is a substantial portion of Flodoard's epic poem.
De triumphis Christi sanctorumque Palestinae - no English translation found for this section of the De triumphis Christi epic.
Historia ecclesiae Remensis - searches found only French translations (Lejeune 1854-55, Guizot 1824), no English translation located despite substantial scholarship on the work.
Invocatio - no English translation found for this very brief opening work (224 words) by Flodoard.
Adnotatiuncula historica - extremely brief work (31 words); no English translation located.
Vita S. Brunonis - no English translation found despite searches; scholarly references exist but translation status unclear.
De locis sanctis - searches found German translation by George Röwekamp (Fontes Christiani 1995) and Latin editions, but no English translation located.
De ortu et obitu Justorum - no English translation found; work appears in Patrologia Latina only.
De viris illustribus Casinensibus - searches found various Latin editions but no complete published English translation located.
Descriptio sacri Casini montis - no English translation found in searches for this brief descriptive work (361 words).
Disciplina Casinensis - no English translation located in searches.
Epistolae - no English translation found for Petrus diaconus's letter collection.
Rythmus de novissimis diebus - Latin verse work on the last days; no English translation located in searches.
De laude eremi - searches found incomplete English transcription in Internet Medieval Sourcebook and passages translated, but no complete modern English translation located.
Epistola paraenetica - work is known to scholars; Erasmus published Latin edition (Basel 1520), but no complete English translation confirmed in searches.
Epitomes operum Cassiani - attribution to Eucherius disputed; searches found no English translation of this work on Cassian's writings.
Exhortatio ad monachos - searches found reference to English translation (YouTube video of complete text in English from PL 50), but source/edition not fully verified.
Formulae spiritalis intelligentiae - 'Formulae of St. Eucherius of Lyons' confirmed available on Christian Classics Ethereal Library (CCEL) as free English translation.
Homiliae - searches indicated Eucherius's Homiliae exist in Patrologia Latina but no English translation located.
Instructiones - searches found references to this work in Latin but no English translation confirmed despite searches for 'Instructiones' and 'Institutiones'.
Passio Agaunensium martyrum - searches mention Vivian & Russell 1999 translation, but cannot fully verify this specific attribution/publication.
